title: PERSONAL STUDIO
rule: own products lead, shown like a studio's showcase: each product gets a room in its own colour and real screens at native pixels; client work comes second, as seven cards with a public screen or a plain figure each
description: A home page led by the owner's own work, with client work second. The first screen opens on Offday, a working multi-tenant time-off app, in a crimson room: the light Shifts week grid at native pixels (2x source, 960 x 600) with a ring on the Needs cover shift. Four equal feature tabs (Shift cover, Best dates, Time to rest, Assistant) each change the screen and ring the part that proves the line. Directly under it (y 898 at 1440), 'Client work' shows seven cards: Bayyinah TV, Viva Fresh, Read to Feed and Dukagjini Bookstore with their public store screenshots (2x sources, never enlarged), Incentiv with its public sign-in screen, and the care platform and Design System v2 as plain figures ('16 → 2 database requests in one billing report. It no longer times out.'; '36 building blocks, 20 releases in about six weeks'), because their screens are private. Then 'Two concepts and a studio site': OFFBEAT (orange room: drum machine, speaker, four finishes, inside) and FORM (ink room: copper, chrome, cast a word) from the new 2x captures as close crops at 1.0 (cast at 0.85), and Snaxx Tech with its 2x phone capture and two plain weight figures.
signature: Bricolage Grotesque 800 for the identity line, room names, figures and card names; Libre Franklin for every other line. Both preloaded, font-display optional, Arial fallbacks sized to them, 300 ms text wait. Palette: paper #F4F1EC, ink #15120F, muted #59534B. Room grounds: Offday crimson #8A1236, OFFBEAT orange #FF6136, FORM on the page ink. Spacing scale 4/8/12/16/24/32/48/64/96; 48 px gutters desktop, 16 px phone. Rooms share one grammar: name, one line, tag, a vertical list of equal tabs (8 px gaps, 24 px to the caption), and a plate. One motion: when a tab changes, the new screen fades in over the old one (opacity 200 ms, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)) and its ring draws in (opacity 160 ms, scale 1.04 to 1 in 200 ms, after 80 ms). Keys (arrows, Home, End) switch at once; reduced motion has no transition. The page sets scroll-behavior auto while it is open, so a Tab move never animates the scroll. The lead image is preloaded with high priority and a 924-byte preview paints under it until it decodes. Phone: rooms are full-bleed bands, tabs a 2-column grid, the current line under the plate; client cards become rows with a 112 x 140 screen.
mechanisms: client cards with public screens or plain figures
holdback: Lowest: actions and seniority 7, not overwhelming 7, original 7. The first screen at 1440 is still all Offday (own lead by rule); client work starts at y 898, so a hiring manager sees client screens only after the first scroll. The page is 4,815 px on desktop and 5,070 px on a 375 phone. Incentiv is a 1x public capture shown at 0.62 to 0.68, so it is soft on a 2x screen and its button text is about 9 px. The phone drum-machine crop shows the whole 8-step grid (critic item 4) at 0.46, so its row labels and step numbers are about 6 px; I followed the critic over the 11 px crop rule there. 'Four finishes' has no phone crop that keeps text at 11 px or more, so the phone shows three OFFBEAT tabs. The 800 px finish crop shows 142 px of the speaker card's left side (cut through empty card space; the 'Acid yellow' label is whole). offbeat-record is not used: its parts span 1,335 px and no plate is that wide at 1.0. On a cold headless profile the optional faces can miss first paint, and that visit keeps the sized Arial fallback (final/d-switch-* frames); the warm d-top has the page faces.
